notes: All 20 clubs in batch 10 were read from the Penn Clubs API entry, and each club website linked there was fetched once, with a few re-checks: 36 fetches and 0 searches (none were needed). Verdicts: 20 publish, 0 hide, 0 not_a_group, 0 duplicate, 0 out_of_area. Statuses: 4 active (IVCF, John Marshall, Keynotes, KDSAP), 10 probably_active (IV Graduate, JHP, JUBA, JSA, Istmo y Vos, Judo, Karate, Kendo, Kesem, KAP), 2 dormant (iNtuitons, JHealth), 4 unknown (Kite and Key, K-PEnSA, KoGSA, KSA). Held back (no summary, categories or interests): iNtuitons under the brief rule for INACTIVE entries, and the four unknowns, which show INACTIVE directory status against an active flag with no current content on their sites. Judgment calls for the owner: IVCF active rests on a regional conference registration dated October 2025 on the chapter Linktree; KDSAP active rests on a 2025 to 2026 school year recap; iNtuitons is dormant from a Spring 2024 season, which the brief would otherwise hold as unknown. KDSAP site calendar entries for Oct 10 and Nov 7, 2026 are labeled sample data and were not used. Personal names and personal-looking emails on the directory were left out for IVCF, JHP and JHealth. Chabad at Penn is named by JHP but has no URL in the data, so it is not listed as a lead. No pages were blocked, and no rate limiting was seen.
